name: Red Dragon Archfiend's Chains
effectText: You can activate this card the turn it was Set, by revealing 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" in your Extra Deck. Activate this card by revealing any number of monsters in your hand, then target Effect Monsters your opponent controls equal to the number of Tuners revealed +1; those monsters lose 100 ATK for each card revealed, also their effects are negated. If none of those monsters are on the field, destroy this card. You can only activate 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend's Chains" per turn.
